data.narrative:
Terranova is a seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $7M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparables universe of 9 private peers and 1 public company (277810.KQ) operating in Robotics & Manufacturing, including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI.

A peer-median approach proved inapplicable due to insufficient narrow-set comparables; the sector contains 11 same-sector peers, but fewer than three meet the same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier filters required for reliable benchmarking. Stage-progression methodology was therefore the primary applicable approach. Using the $7M total raised as a valuation proxy and applying a 2.5x multiplier typical of seed-to-next-stage transitions yields an implied value of $18M.

The triangulated analysis supports a valuation range of $15M to $20M, with a median of $18M. The single-method reliance represents a material limitation; meaningful refinement would require either expansion of the usable peer set or additional transaction-based or revenue multiple data for early-stage robotics companies. Key uncertainties include the representativeness of the 2.5x step-up multiplier for this specific subsector and the absence of comparable-company revenue or unit economics data.
